newsitem.title: POLAND: ZLOTY EASES VS BASKET, DEPOS DOWN DESPITE DRAINAGE.
newsitem.headline: ZLOTY EASES VS BASKET, DEPOS DOWN DESPITE DRAINAGE.

text.p: 1240 GMT - The Polish zloty closed at 1.51/1.47 pct from the trading band centre, weaker than Wednesday's 1.58/1.53 pct as the market fell below strong resistance at 1.5 percent as a result of some early currency-buying.
* It closed at 3.2450/70 to the dollar, down from 3.2367/77 on Wednesday and at 1.8727/32 to the mark, up from 1.8741/54.
* O/N close lower at 21.00/21.30 pct vs opening's 21.60/21.70. T/N at 21.30/21.60 vs 21.60/21.75 despite a 1.93 billion zloty central bank drainage on Thursday.
* Polish net forex reserves up $641 million in May to $21.713 billion. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
